description: Secondary content that appears while its scope is hovered, focused, or holds an open menu, and always shows on touch.

files.content: # Reveal > Secondary content that appears while its scope is hovered, focused, or holds an open menu, and always shows on touch. This file matches the installed `reveal` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/reveal.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/reveal.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/reveal-knobs`: `revealKnobs`, types `RevealKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/reveal`: `RevealScope`, `Reveal`, types `RevealScopeProps`, `RevealProps` ## Composition ### Row with hover actions Hover, keyboard focus, or an open menu inside the nearest RevealScope shows its Reveal content; touch screens always show it. ```tsx row content Download Move to trash ))} ); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `reveal` - `content` - `scope` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### reveal - `--cui-reveal-hidden-opacity`: `0` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/reveal - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/reveal.json
